hotels_prior_results = get_results_from_cache(key=hotels_cache_key)

# Apply the 3-star filter to the cached hotel results

    prior_results=hotels_prior_results,
    stars=[3, 5]  # At least 3 stars (using max 5 as upper bound)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache

# Save the restaurant results directly as no additional filtering is requested

# Output the results to the user
